replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
In my opinion, some major improvements need to be made before making the YML:

Mining
Sure, this map is all about miners, to an extent however there is way too much resources in the cave system. I had barely walked 10 blocks into the cave and saw 2 sets of iron armour worth of iron ore. This just makes the map so easy and boring.
What you can do: Decrease the frequency in which coal, iron and diamond ores are found.

Trees
This is favoured towards the aesthetic feel, but the trees are too tall, plain and unnatural...
What you can do: Add detail to the trunk, and shorten the height by... what, 10 blocks?

Block choice
Now, I am seeing 1.8 exclusive blocks... What would happen to 1.7 client users? Please use 1.7 blocks for the time being, so the map can support both versions!
Also, please remove the mob spawner. Mobs are disabled.

In order for a complete YAML, you need to rotate the 'squadrant' three times (to fill the empty ones).
Please take this feedback into consideration :)))
Good luck!
